description: One export run of one dataset of a data sink, scheduled or part of a backfill, over a range of event time: the export history. Customers read it; only the export service writes it. Retries keep the run ID and range. A failed run can adopt corrected configuration and restart the range, updating its configuration versions and resetting execution progress.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

attempts.description: The number of failed attempts so far.
attempts.title: attempts

backfillID.description: The backfill of the run, for a Backfill run.
backfillID.title: backfillID

bytesWritten.description: Bytes written to the destination for the current configuration execution. May reset when the run restarts with corrected configuration.
bytesWritten.title: bytesWritten

dataSinkID.description: The ID of the data sink.
dataSinkID.title: dataSinkID

dataset.description: The dataset exported: AccessLogs corresponds to access_logs, and AgenticLogs to agentic_logs in the customer output.
dataset.title: dataset

definitionVersion.description: The version of the dataset definition the run uses. The export service may update it when restarting a failed run with corrected configuration.
definitionVersion.title: definitionVersion

endTime.description: When the run stopped or succeeded. Cleared when execution resumes.
endTime.title: endTime

error.description: The last error, sanitized by the export service before validation.
error.title: error

filesWritten.description: Files written to the destination for the current configuration execution. May reset when the run restarts with corrected configuration.
filesWritten.title: filesWritten

kind.description: Whether the run is a scheduled export or part of a backfill.
kind.title: kind

rangeEnd.description: The end of the exported range in event time, UTC, exclusive.
rangeEnd.title: rangeEnd

rangeStart.description: The start of the exported range in event time, UTC, inclusive.
rangeStart.title: rangeStart

revision.description: The data sink revision the run uses. The export service may update it when restarting a failed run with corrected configuration.
revision.title: revision

rowsDropped.description: Rows read but not exported for the current configuration execution, such as rows the data sink filters exclude. May reset on a configuration-changing restart.
rowsDropped.title: rowsDropped

rowsRead.description: Rows read from the logs for the current configuration execution. May reset when the run restarts with corrected configuration.
rowsRead.title: rowsRead

rowsWritten.description: Rows written to the destination for the current configuration execution. May reset when the run restarts with corrected configuration.
rowsWritten.title: rowsWritten

runID.description: The run identifier, chosen by the export service. Unique: creating a run with an existing ID returns that run.
runID.title: runID

startTime.description: When the run first started. Preserved across retries and restarts.
startTime.title: startTime

status.description: Running, Failing (attempts keep failing), Failed (failing for 24 hours; the data sink goes to Error), or Succeeded. Failing and Failed runs can retry and later succeed. Corrected configuration can restart the same run and range with updated versions and reset execution progress. Only Succeeded is terminal.
status.title: status

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: DataSinkRun
